name: Mafia De Cuba
summary: Social deduction where a Godfather interrogates henchmen to find who stole diamonds from his cigar box.
rules_text: Setup: one player is Godfather, others sit clockwise. Godfather puts 10-15 diamonds and role tokens (Loyal Henchmen, FBI/CIA Agents, Drivers, Cleaner) in the cigar box per player count, secretly pockets 0-5 diamonds, and has 0-2 Jokers. Theft: box passes clockwise. Each player secretly looks inside, memorizes contents, then must discreetly take either at least 1 diamond or 1 role token and hide it. First player may also discard one role token into a bag. If box is empty you become Street Urchin and pretend to take. Last player may take nothing to become Urchin. Taking illegally eliminates you. Investigation: Godfather recovers box, interrogates in any order. Players may lie or stay silent. Godfather accuses by saying "empty your pockets!". If accused had diamonds, they are returned and thief eliminated. If accused had no diamonds, Godfather must give a Joker; if no Jokers left, Godfather eliminated. If an Agent is accused, Agent wins immediately and ends game. If Godfather recovers all stolen diamonds, Godfather and Henchmen win. If Godfather eliminated, richest remaining thief wins, with Urchins and adjacent Drivers sharing victory.
rating_reason: Hidden role stealing box with interrogation, bluffing perfect
